system.description: 1 pt: –2 to Persuasion and Sneak. 3 pts (Chronic): each session, Fair (5) Vigor roll or suffer –4 to all tasks that session. 5 pts (Fatal): as Chronic, but a bust on that same roll also forces an Onerous (7) Vigor roll — fail it and risk death. Set points to actual tier purchased. dlc p.52.
